_comment: ServerCore game server egg. Import through Admin > Nests > Import Egg (PTDL_v2).
name: ServerCore (Folia)
author: bejiihiu.xs
description:
Folia 26.3 server for the ServerCore network: downloads Folia from the PaperMC v3 API, PacketEvents 2.14.0 (hard dependency), and the ServerCore plugin from its GitHub release, then writes plugins/ServerCore/config.yml with the backend gateway link already filled in.

Allocate port 25565 (the primary allocation is written into server.properties). Java 25 is mandatory: the plugin is compiled for a Java 25 toolchain and will not load on 21. Backend Gateway URL must be the public wss://host[:port]/ws endpoint - the gateway answers 404 on any other path, and the Server ID + Server Secret must match SERVERCORE_SERVER_CREDENTIALS on the backend.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# ServerCore game server install: Folia + PacketEvents + the ServerCore plugin,
# pre-wired to the backend gateway from the egg variables.
#
# files land in /mnt/server:
#   folia.jar                     the server (Server Jar File variable)
#   plugins/PacketEvents-<v>.jar  hard plugin dependency
#   plugins/ServerCore-<tag>.jar  the plugin, checked against the release's SHA256SUMS.txt
#   plugins/ServerCore/config.yml only when absent, with the backend link filled in

set -eu

UA="Pterodactyl (https://pterodactyl.io) ServerCore egg"
FOLIA_API="https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/folia"

# sha256 of a file, empty when the install container has neither tool
sha256_of() {
    if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        sha256sum "$1" | awk '{print $1}'
    elif command -v openssl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        openssl dgst -sha256 "$1" | awk '{print $NF}'
    else
        echo ""
    fi
}

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
mkdir -p plugins

# --- folia -------------------------------------------------------------------
# the v2 papermc api is gone (410); v3 is the only working one.
# /versions/<v> gives { builds: [28, 27, ...] }, /builds/<n> carries the url.
VERSION="${FOLIA_VERSION:-26.3}"
BUILD="${FOLIA_BUILD:-latest}"

echo "resolving folia ${VERSION}"

if ! curl -fsSL -A "${UA}" -o /tmp/folia-version.json "${FOLIA_API}/versions/${VERSION}"; then
    echo "error: folia version ${VERSION} is not published (check Folia Version)"
    exit 1
fi

if [ "${BUILD}" = "latest" ]; then
    BUILD=$(jq -r '.builds[0] // empty' /tmp/folia-version.json)
    if [ -z "${BUILD}" ]; then
        echo "error: no builds for folia ${VERSION}"
        exit 1
    fi
else
    if ! jq -e --arg b "${BUILD}" '.builds | map(tostring) | index($b)' /tmp/folia-version.json >/dev/null; then
        echo "error: folia ${VERSION} has no build ${BUILD} (use latest or a build from the api)"
        exit 1
    fi
fi

if ! curl -fsSL -A "${UA}" -o /tmp/folia-build.json "${FOLIA_API}/versions/${VERSION}/builds/${BUILD}"; then
    echo "error: could not read folia ${VERSION} build ${BUILD}"
    exit 1
fi

FOLIA_URL=$(jq -r '.downloads."server:default".url // empty' /tmp/folia-build.json)
FOLIA_SHA=$(jq -r '.downloads."server:default".checksums.sha256 // empty' /tmp/folia-build.json)
if [ -z "${FOLIA_URL}" ]; then
    echo "error: build ${BUILD} has no server download"
    exit 1
fi

echo "downloading folia ${VERSION} build ${BUILD}"
if [ -f "${SERVER_JARFILE}" ]; then
    mv "${SERVER_JARFILE}" "${SERVER_JARFILE}.old"
fi
curl -fsSL -A "${UA}" -o "${SERVER_JARFILE}" "${FOLIA_URL}"

if [ -n "${FOLIA_SHA}" ]; then
    ACTUAL=$(sha256_of "${SERVER_JARFILE}")
    if [ -z "${ACTUAL}" ]; then
        echo "warn: no sha256sum/openssl in the install container, skipping the folia checksum"
    elif [ "${ACTUAL}" != "${FOLIA_SHA}" ]; then
        echo "error: ${SERVER_JARFILE} sha256 mismatch (expected ${FOLIA_SHA})"
        exit 1
    fi
fi

# --- packetevents ------------------------------------------------------------
# required: true in the plugin's metadata, so the build always installs it
PE="${PE_VERSION:-2.14.0}"
echo "downloading packetevents ${PE}"
curl -fsSL -A "${UA}" -o "plugins/PacketEvents-${PE}.jar" \
    "https://github.com/retrooper/packetevents/releases/download/v${PE}/packetevents-spigot-${PE}.jar"

# --- servercore plugin -------------------------------------------------------
# release tags are build-<commitCount>-<shortSha>, and the asset is
# ServerCore-<tag>.jar. the plugin's own updater picks the same assets later.
REPO="${PLUGIN_REPO:-bejiihiu/ServerCore}"
RELEASE="${PLUGIN_RELEASE:-latest}"
TAG=""

gh_get() {
    if [ -n "${GITHUB_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
        curl -fsSL -A "${UA}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer ${GITHUB_TOKEN}" "$@"
    else
        curl -fsSL -A "${UA}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" "$@"
    fi
}

if [ "${RELEASE}" = "latest" ]; then
    RELEASE_URL="https://api.github.com/repos/${REPO}/releases/latest"
else
    RELEASE_URL="https://api.github.com/repos/${REPO}/releases/tags/${RELEASE}"
fi

if ! gh_get -o /tmp/servercore-release.json "${RELEASE_URL}"; then
    echo "error: could not read release '${RELEASE}' from ${REPO}"
    echo "       set GitHub Token if the anonymous api limit is exhausted"
    exit 1
fi

TAG=$(jq -r '.tag_name // empty' /tmp/servercore-release.json)
ASSET_NAME=$(jq -r '[.assets[].name | select(test("^ServerCore-build-[0-9]+-[0-9a-f]+\\.jar$"))][0] // empty' /tmp/servercore-release.json)
ASSET_URL=$(jq -r --arg n "${ASSET_NAME}" '[.assets[] | select(.name == $n) | .browser_download_url][0] // empty' /tmp/servercore-release.json)

if [ -z "${TAG}" ] || [ -z "${ASSET_NAME}" ] || [ -z "${ASSET_URL}" ]; then
    echo "error: release listing has no ServerCore-build-<count>-<sha>.jar asset"
    exit 1
fi

echo "downloading ${ASSET_NAME} (${TAG})"
gh_get -o "plugins/${ASSET_NAME}" "${ASSET_URL}"

# same checksum file the in-plugin updater trusts
if curl -fsSL -A "${UA}" -o /tmp/SHA256SUMS.txt \
    "https://github.com/${REPO}/releases/download/${TAG}/SHA256SUMS.txt"; then
    EXPECTED=$(grep "  ${ASSET_NAME}\$" /tmp/SHA256SUMS.txt | awk '{print $1}' || true)
    ACTUAL=$(sha256_of "plugins/${ASSET_NAME}")
    if [ -z "${ACTUAL}" ]; then
        echo "warn: no sha256sum/openssl in the install container, skipping the jar checksum"
    elif [ -z "${EXPECTED}" ] || [ "${EXPECTED}" != "${ACTUAL}" ]; then
        echo "error: ${ASSET_NAME} does not match SHA256SUMS.txt"
        exit 1
    fi
else
    echo "warn: SHA256SUMS.txt not available, skipping the jar checksum"
fi

# --- plugin config -----------------------------------------------------------
# the plugin writes config.yml itself on first boot and then disables itself
# because backend.url is empty. write the shipped config with the backend block
# already filled in instead, so the first boot is a working boot. an existing
# config.yml is never touched: panel edits survive a reinstall.
CONFIG=plugins/ServerCore/config.yml

if [ -f "${CONFIG}" ]; then
    echo "keeping the existing ${CONFIG}"
else
    mkdir -p plugins/ServerCore
    BACKEND_URL="${BACKEND_URL:-}"
    SERVER_ID="${SERVER_ID:-}"
    BACKEND_SECRET="${BACKEND_SECRET:-}"

    if [ -z "${BACKEND_URL}" ] || [ -z "${SERVER_ID}" ] || [ -z "${BACKEND_SECRET}" ]; then
        echo "warn: Backend Gateway URL / Server ID / Server Secret not all set"
        echo "      the plugin will generate its config.yml and disable itself on first boot"
    else
        # shape checks: a stray quote or ampersand here would corrupt the yaml
        # (or the sed), and the gateway rejects anything but the /ws path
        echo "${BACKEND_URL}" | grep -Eq '^wss?://[A-Za-z0-9.-]+(:[0-9]+)?/ws$' \
            || { echo "error: Backend Gateway URL must look like wss://host[:port]/ws"; exit 1; }
        echo "${SERVER_ID}" | grep -Eq '^[a-z0-9._-]{1,64}$' \
            || { echo "error: Server ID must match [a-z0-9._-]+ (max 64)"; exit 1; }
        echo "${BACKEND_SECRET}" | grep -Eq '^[A-Za-z0-9._~+/=-]{32,256}$' \
            || { echo "error: Server Secret must be 32+ chars of [A-Za-z0-9._~+/=-]"; exit 1; }

        curl -fsSL -A "${UA}" -o "${CONFIG}" \
            "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/${REPO}/${TAG}/plugin/src/main/resources/config.yml" \
            || { echo "error: could not fetch the shipped config.yml for ${TAG}"; exit 1; }

        sed -i "s|^  url: \"\"|  url: \"${BACKEND_URL}\"|" "${CONFIG}"
        sed -i "s|^  server-id: \"game-1\"|  server-id: \"${SERVER_ID}\"|" "${CONFIG}"
        sed -i "s|^  secret: \"\"|  secret: \"${BACKEND_SECRET}\"|" "${CONFIG}"

        grep -qx "  url: \"${BACKEND_URL}\"" "${CONFIG}" \
            || { echo "error: backend url did not land in config.yml"; exit 1; }
        grep -qx "  server-id: \"${SERVER_ID}\"" "${CONFIG}" \
            || { echo "error: backend server-id did not land in config.yml"; exit 1; }
        grep -qx "  secret: \"${BACKEND_SECRET}\"" "${CONFIG}" \
            || { echo "error: backend secret did not land in config.yml"; exit 1; }

        echo "wrote ${CONFIG} with the backend link"
    fi
fi

echo "install complete: folia ${VERSION} build ${BUILD}, packetevents ${PE}, plugin ${TAG}"

variables.name: Server Jar File
variables.description: Name of the Folia jar in the server root. Leave as is unless you have a reason.

variables.name: Folia Version
variables.description: Minecraft version to install from the PaperMC v3 API. The plugin declares api-version 26.3, so 26.3 or newer is required. Reinstall the server to apply a change.

variables.name: Folia Build
variables.description: Folia build number for that version, or latest for the newest stable build. The install fails if the build does not exist. Reinstall the server to apply a change.

variables.name: PacketEvents Version
variables.description: PacketEvents release to install (the plugin refuses to enable without it). The release tag carries a v prefix: 2.14.0 downloads v2.14.0.

variables.name: Plugin Repository
variables.description: owner/repo the plugin jar is released from. The asset must be named ServerCore-build-<count>-<sha>.jar.

variables.name: Plugin Release
variables.description: Release tag to install, for example build-194-dc8a896, or latest for the newest one. The jar is verified against the release's SHA256SUMS.txt.

variables.name: Backend Gateway URL
variables.description: Public websocket url of the backend gateway, ending in /ws, for example wss://mc-api.example.com/ws. The plugin connects outbound to it; the gateway answers 404 on every other path.

variables.name: Server ID
variables.description: Unique id of this game server, [a-z0-9._-], the key in the backend's SERVERCORE_SERVER_CREDENTIALS.

variables.name: Server Secret
variables.description: Per-server HMAC secret from SERVERCORE_SERVER_CREDENTIALS, at least 32 characters (openssl rand -hex 32). Generate a fresh one per server.

variables.name: GitHub Token
variables.description: Optional. Only lifts the anonymous GitHub API rate limit while installing; a fine-grained token with public repo read access is enough. Not needed for normal operation.
